items.result: Attendance, leave, and vacations in a single system, with monthly reports ready for deduction calculations.
items.description: MoCA (Attendance Control Module) is the internal application INDECI uses, within its Integrated Human Resources System, to manage its employees' working hours. anvynt developed it to record punctuality, check-ins, check-outs, and time on site, process leave slips, licenses, and the vacation schedule, and consolidate each employee's monthly record for administrative reports and deduction calculations.
items.metaTitle: Attendance, Leave, and Vacation Control for the Public Sector | anvynt Case Study
items.metaDescription: MoCA: the Attendance Control Module anvynt built for INDECI to manage attendance, leave, licenses, vacations, and monthly reports for its staff.
items.resumenSolucion: Attendance, leave, and vacation module with monthly per-employee reports.
tecnologias: Leave slip, license, and vacation workflow
Integration with the Integrated HR System

enfoque.objetivo: Replace manual working-hours control with a single module that records attendance, streamlines leave and vacation requests, and delivers a reliable monthly record for every employee.
acciones: Assessed the working-hours rules, tolerances, leave types, and licenses that apply to public servants.
Designed check-in, check-out, and time-on-site tracking to measure each employee's punctuality.
Built the request and approval workflow for leave slips, licenses, and the vacation schedule.
Integrated the module with the Integrated Human Resources System and generated monthly reports.

solucion.texto: anvynt developed MoCA, the module that manages INDECI employees' working hours within its Integrated Human Resources System, from daily clock-in to the monthly report.

capacidades.descripcion: Records punctuality, check-ins, check-outs, and staff time on site at the institution.
Lets staff process, approve, and manage leave slips, licenses, and the vacation schedule for public servants.
Consolidates each employee's attendance record to produce administrative reports and calculate the corresponding deductions.

impacto.texto: MoCA brought INDECI's working-hours management into a single module and left each employee's record ready for administrative use.
beneficios: Attendance, punctuality, and time on site recorded in a single system.
Leave slips, licenses, and the vacation schedule processed and approved in the same workflow.
Consolidated monthly record per employee, ready for administrative reports.
Deduction calculations based on consistent attendance data.

items.result: 100% auditable platform with smart validations and full information traceability.
items.description: Data collection and consolidation processes were carried out manually, generating inconsistencies and making institutional analysis difficult. anvynt developed FEPMA Verifica, a web system that automates data capture, incorporates validation rules and dynamic forms, ensures integrity control and traceability for every record, and exports solid, consistent information ready for data analysis and the generation of statistical indicators for national management and oversight.
items.metaTitle: Data Automation for the Ombudsman's Office | anvynt Case Study
items.metaDescription: FEPMA Verifica: the platform anvynt built to automate the capture, validation, and traceability of the Ombudsman's Office's institutional data.
items.resumenSolucion: Data capture and validation platform with full traceability per record.

enfoque.objetivo: Replace manual, inconsistency-prone information collection with a system that captures, validates, and consolidates data automatically and traceably.
acciones: Mapped the manual data collection and consolidation processes in place.
Designed dynamic forms adapted to the institution's different record types.
Defined validation rules to guarantee the integrity of every captured record.
Built an export module ready for data analysis and statistical indicators.

solucion.texto: anvynt developed FEPMA Verifica, a web system that automates data capture and applies smart validations to every record, delivering solid information ready for national oversight.

capacidades.descripcion: Dynamic forms that replace manual collection and reduce the margin for error.
Validation and integrity rules applied at the moment of capture, not after the fact.
Every record is linked to its origin and history, available for audit.

impacto.texto: FEPMA Verifica changed how the Ombudsman's Office collects and analyzes its institutional information.
beneficios: 100% auditable platform, with full traceability for every record.
Smart validations that remove inconsistencies at the data's source.
Information ready for data analysis and statistical indicator generation.
Direct support for national-level management and oversight.

items.result: Full CAS recruitment cycle digitized, from position request to hiring, with a public portal for applicants.
items.description: CAS staff recruitment processes —position request, publication, application, evaluation and hiring— were handled in a scattered way, with no single applicant file and no traceability of each stage. anvynt developed SISCONV, a system that digitizes the entire recruitment lifecycle, with a public portal for applicants and an institutional system for internal management, and that also adds an artificial intelligence layer as added value.
items.metaTitle: AI-Powered CAS Recruitment System for Defense | anvynt Case Study
items.metaDescription: SISCONV: the recruitment system anvynt built for the Armed Forces Procurement Agency, with an applicant portal, selection, transparency and hiring.
items.resumenSolucion: Web system that digitizes the CAS recruitment lifecycle, with a public portal, online selection and an AI layer as added value.
tecnologias: JWT security and role-based access control
Artificial intelligence applied to selection (added value)

enfoque.objetivo: Replace the scattered management of CAS recruitment with a single, transparent and traceable digital flow that supports both applicants and the institution at every stage.
acciones: Mapped the CAS recruitment cycle and the roles involved at each stage.
Designed a public portal for applicants and an institutional system for internal management.
Built the modules for position requests, recruitment calls, applications, selection, notifications and hiring.
Recorded audit and transparency logs for the relevant actions in the process.

solucion.texto: anvynt developed SISCONV, a system covering the full recruitment cycle: position request, recruitment call, application, virtual file, selection, notifications, transparency and hiring.

capacidades.descripcion: Browse public calls, register, apply online, keep a virtual file, file objections, see results and take the virtual exam.
Résumé review, technical evaluation and interview handled in the same flow, with a question bank for the exams.
Position requests, recruitment calls, notifications, contracts and user and area administration, with access based on each user's role.
Relevant actions are recorded in a transparency log, available for audit.
AI assistance for screening applicant files, summarizing profiles against the job profile and supporting applicants, always with the final decision left to the institution.

impacto.texto: SISCONV brought CAS recruitment management into a single system, with a digital, transparent and traceable selection process.
beneficios: Full recruitment cycle in one system, from position request to hiring.
Online application and follow-up for applicants, with a virtual file.
Traceability and transparency at every stage of the selection process.
A foundation ready to add artificial intelligence that speeds up file review.
